capabilities: Render notes and resolved internal links as an interactive 3D graph
Search note titles and inspect them in a Markdown detail pane
Open the selected note file in Obsidian
Rebuild the graph automatically after vault or link changes
Filter by folder and limit the number of notes displayed
disambiguation: Not an AI or 'second brain' reasoning tool; the graph only maps files and links and runs no Hooks, Laya, or AI features.
extras: Version 0.1.0 failed the community directory review; version 0.1.1 passed automated scanning but a manual review is still pending. Mobile is not supported in the first release, and note positions carry no semantic meaning.
intentEvidence: This plugin adapts the visual language of the AI Second Brain Lab practice repo.
motivation: The author built it as the plugin form of the AI Second Brain Lab practice repo, narrowing it to only the read-only 3D vault viewer.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph shows notes and links in 2D, and some users want an exploratory 3D map of the vault instead.

summary: Renders the vault's Markdown notes and resolved internal links as an interactive Three.js 3D graph with search, a detail pane, and one-click note opening.
